ms.promise:
The development of the analytics application consists of multiple parts in the backend: a custom PRISM-Node (previously called “Node-Connector” In the architectural diagrams), which reads the blockchains and extracts all PRISM operations. A backend for the analytics-platform which calculates statistical information and provides endpoints to query the extracted PRISM operations. And lastly a frontend application which displays the operations, statistical data and offers advanced functionality to interact with the PRISM data. Together they form the analytics-application.
(A) Development of a PRISM Node with the capability to read the blockchain and parse the PRISM operations on the blockchain (on PreProduction network)
(B) Development of a analytics-application with a web-frontend which is able to display the PRISM operations found by the node.
(C) Development of a feature inside the analytics-application which is also able to do a basic statistical analysis.
ms.criteria:
(A) + (B) : A working website which displays all the PRISM blocks found on the PreProduction network in near real-time.
(C): The Website also offers basic statistical information. E.g., number of PRISM transaction in the last 30 days.

ms.promise:
The graph-view is the most important, but also most complicated, feature. It will be delivered in two steps. First, in this milestone, a simple UI which displays the graph correctly. In the next milestone, we’ll take the feedback and learnings and refine the graph-view, while also adding features. The application should still be ready for usage for the general public at the time of finishing this milestone.
(A) A resolver which calculates the relationship between DIDs based on a list of DIDs and VCs.
(B) A webpage which displays the relationship between DIDs and VCs as a graph or similar mechanism to get a visual overview over the connections.
(C) A user-specific storage of selected DIDs and VCs to display them in a graph.
(D) Possibilities to extend or reduce an already created graph with new DIDs and VCs.
ms.criteria:
(A) + (B): A website which shows a graph based on a preselected set of DIDs and VCs.
(C) Features to save the graph and reload the graph after reloading the page.
(D) Features to expand the graph by adding additional DIDs or VCs in the user-interface.

Key Performance Indicator (KPI):
- Provide insights into on-chain adoption: 
 The PRISM Analytics Platform delivered comprehensive statistics over nearly two years, offering insight into adoption trends on-chain. By leveraging knowledge of how decentralized identifiers (DIDs) worked for PRISM v1 and v2, users could track ongoing developments. This project became well-known and frequently referenced within the community, as there is no comparable application.
 
Achievements:
- The platform helped multiple developers better understand the processes behind DIDs, especially since most aspects of how DIDs are written to the blockchain remain closed-source (except for our tools).
- The data and graphing tools were showcased in multiple community calls, and at the most recent Internet Identity Workshop (IIW) conference, where they reached industry leaders.
